meshImportNotes: Dog riders are rigged and animated: ../shared/riders/SK_{Kefla,Koda,Crash}.fbx (40k tris, vertex colours, 33-bone Rigify deform-only skeleton with a single root, 1.1 m, -Y forward / Z up, six baked clips CCG_Stance/Idle/Crouch/Pop/Push/Grind at 30 fps). rig_rider.py next to them is the reproducible Blender pipeline.

UEFN imports FBX skeletal meshes for PROPS and NPCs only (Modeling / Skeletal Mesh import -> NPC Spawner character or an animated prop via Sequencer). Fortnite players cannot wear custom skeletal meshes: dog classes get a Fortnite character with a dog-themed wrap; the SK_* meshes stand on the rider podiums, results and store display, or run as NPC spawner companions playing CCG_Idle / CCG_Push.

Import settings: Convert Scene + Force Front XAxis (Blender -Y forward), uniform scale 100 if the mesh arrives 1.1 uu tall, vertex colour import = Replace (no UV-mapped texture yet; use a Vertex Color material). Nanite OFF for skeletal meshes (ON is fine for custom static props, see UEFN_GRAPHICS.md); add LODs (LOD0 40k, LOD1 15k, LOD2 5k) to stay inside the island memory budget.
Decks and clothing from the store catalog are names only in the data; author placeholder deck meshes (Skatepark gallery deck prop) and label them with Billboard devices.
galleries: Retail Row / Tilted Towers building galleries
knownLimits: UEFN has no native grind physics; ccg_rail implements a teleport-along-marker-chain tick (see file header for the trade-off vs cinematic_sequence_device).
Vagamundo barrier is a world object: it opens for all players once any player masters P2+P3+P4.
Flat tricks (ollie/kickflip/...) need an input or animation hook calling ccg_game_manager.AwardTrick/Land/Bail; debug buttons are provided.
Scoring and rider constants are duplicated in Verse (re-sync by hand); the store catalog is regenerated with ../shared/gen_store.py when ccg_data.json changes.
